create_IsolationForest: create an IsolationForest model for anomaly detection on 2D data with configurable max_samples
train_IsolationForest: train an IsolationForest model on stratified train/test split data
test_IsolationForest_predict: test the IsolationForest predict method to classify samples as outliers or inliers
review_IsolationForest_decision_function: review the IsolationForest decision_function to get path-length-based anomaly scores
build_DecisionBoundaryDisplay: build a DecisionBoundaryDisplay visualization of IsolationForest binary decision boundary on 2D data
